properties.name: server.port
properties.description: Server HTTP port. The server factory uses 8080 when unset; 0 picks a free port.

properties.name: server.address
properties.description: Network address to which the server should bind.

properties.name: server.server-header
properties.description: Value to use for the Server response header (if empty, no header is sent).

properties.name: server.shutdown
properties.description: Type of shutdown that the server will support.

properties.name: server.compression.mime-types
properties.description: Comma-separated list of MIME types that should be compressed.

properties.name: server.compression.additional-mime-types
properties.description: Comma-separated list of additional MIME types that should be compressed.

properties.name: server.compression.excluded-user-agents
properties.description: Comma-separated list of user agents for which responses should not be compressed.

properties.name: server.http2.enabled
properties.description: Whether to enable HTTP/2 support, if the current environment supports it.

properties.name: server.servlet.path
properties.description: Path of the dispatcher servlet. Setting a custom value for this property is not compatible with the PathPatternParser matching strategy.

properties.name: server.servlet.load-on-startup
properties.description: Load on startup priority of the dispatcher servlet.

properties.name: server.flint.threads
properties.description: Number of reactor threads serving requests. 0 uses every CPU the process may run on, up to 16, as Tomcat's request thread pool spans the CPUs.

properties.name: server.flint.max-handlers
properties.description: Maximum number of requests handled at once, across the reactor threads, as Tomcat's server.tomcat.threads.max. Requests past it wait on their connections. 0 runs one handler per connection slot.

properties.name: server.tomcat.max-keep-alive-requests
properties.description: Maximum number of HTTP requests that can be pipelined before the connection is closed. When set to 0 or 1, keep-alive and pipelining are disabled. When set to -1, an unlimited number of pipelined or keep-alive requests are allowed.
